style: Cinematic painted key art in an archival 1950s film look for a real-time strategy game: soft film grain, silver and warm tungsten light, deep shadows, pale blue electric light, rich detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: slow melancholic brass waltz under old film crackle, low strings, a fragile music box motif, the distant hum of a giant machine, swelling to one sustained chord at the end, no vocals

shots.prompt: A vast underground machine hall under a mountain in 1953: a huge spherical time machine of brass rings and glass coils on a raised platform, crackling with pale blue electric arcs, thick cables across a concrete floor. An elderly scientist with wild white hair and a white moustache, in a grey cardigan, stands alone at a long control desk of dials and levers, small against the machine.
shots.line: Nineteen fifty-three. The war is over, and Albert Einstein has one task left: switch off the machine that started it.

shots.prompt: A formal black-and-white 1950s photograph lying on a wooden desk under a lamp: a grand state room with heavy curtains, a row of stern officials in dark suits and uniforms, and in the middle of the row a crisp man-shaped blank gap cut out of the print, white paper showing through where a man once stood.
shots.line: In every photograph of the old court, one place is empty. His name was Arkady Orlov.

shots.prompt: A young woman commando in 1950s fatigues and webbing, dark hair tied back, sleeves rolled, pistol in hand, running hard down a long concrete bunker corridor lit by red alarm lamps, steam from the pipes, seen from the front at a low angle, fierce and fast.
shots.line: The Allies sent their best commando to bring him in.
shots.action: She runs toward the camera; the alarm lamps pulse and steam drifts.

shots.prompt: The time machine firing: a blinding white and pale blue core of light on the brass platform, a man in a long dark overcoat seen only as a black silhouette stepping into the light, and a woman commando leaping from the metal stairs to grab his coat, sparks and rings of energy around them.
shots.line: He reached the machine first. She reached him.
shots.action: The core of light flares brighter and the rings of energy spin.

shots.prompt: The same underground machine hall moments later, empty: the brass platform smoking, the last blue arcs dying along the rings, the elderly white-haired scientist at the control desk looking up at the machine, a radio set on the desk with its needle still swinging.
shots.line: The Chronosphere fell silent. Its echo did not.

shots.prompt: Dawn in the present day over a Red Sea coast: a modern coastal radar on a rocky hill has just stopped turning, its warning light going out, a coastal highway below in blue morning mist, and a faint ghostly flicker in the air like an old film frame.
shots.line: Seventy-three years later, on a coast at dawn, a radar goes quiet.
